lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a structured grid pattern posterior to the gills, consisting of approximately 5-6 discernible vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, creating a series of rectangular grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with a higher spatial concentration observed along the anterior edge and basal region.

other_distinctive_markers: A congregation of small, high-chroma yellow pixel clusters (commensal teleosts) is present in the ventral-anterior region, primarily clustered below the head and pectoral fin.
